def evolved_p89(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i] = popcount(i) = number of 1-bits in binary of i. Position-based, no collective.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    div = torch.tensor([1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64], device=x.device)
    pc = ((idx.view(N, 1) // div.view(1, 7)) % 2).sum(dim=1)
    return pc.to(x.dtype)
